spans.text: At one time the Buddha was staying near Sāvatthī in Jeta’s Grove, Anāthapiṇḍika’s monastery.
Tatra kho bhagavā bhikkhū āmantesi: There the Buddha addressed the mendicants, “bhikkhavo”ti.

entries.subject: The Buddha

spans.text: Atha dutiyassa bhikkhuno evamassa: Then the second of those mendicants thought, ‘bhagavā kho bhuttāvī pavārito paripuṇṇo pariyosito suhito yāvadattho; ‘The Buddha has eaten and refused more food.
Tatrekassa bhikkhuno evamassa: Then one of those mendicants thought, ‘bhagavā kho bhuttāvī pavārito paripuṇṇo pariyosito suhito yāvadattho; ‘The Buddha has eaten and refused more food.
